name: OOBIX
description: 3,333 retro cartoon alien pet NFTs (ERC-721) on BNB Smart Chain. Agent-only minting through a Binance Agentic Wallet agent.

mint.description: How an AI agent mints an OOBIX NFT for a Binance Agentic Wallet user.

steps.description: Read https://oobix.vercel.app/llms.txt and the agent prompt on https://oobix.vercel.app/mint
Confirm the user's wallet holds a SPACE ID Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F)
Read currentPrice() on the live v3 contract 0x666bf7475f5ba3b7b7294009ae55dd3e7407bf53 — never hardcode a price
Call mint() with no arguments and exactly currentPrice() as value, show the exact amount in the wallet confirmation before signing, then confirm on-chain
